description: Use this when an agent needs to understand how AgentBodega x402 and L402 payment discovery work before making paid HTTP calls. It explains the blockchain-settled per-call model, discovery URLs, balance source of truth, optional owner-approved savings offers, and an optional sample challenge request. It does not validate wallets, issue discounts, or perform payments.

includeCurl.description: When true, include a sample curl command for requesting a live 402 payment challenge.

name: agentbodega_payment_guide
title: AgentBodega Payment Guide
